text:
Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet planters
Materials: Iron
This casual planter in cement and gold tones looks great on a table with your favorite plant or fairy garden. The open gold stand brings interest and beauty to your airy indoor garden, while the neutral tones help bring together the other colors in the room. 12.2" diameter x 15.94"H 100% iron This casual cement-hued planter in a gold-toned stand looks great with most decors. Wipe clean with a soft, dry cloth.
